narrative.northStar: Split Studio: care-team follow-through made visible with Swiss editorial precision.
narrative.overview: A square four-panel grid pairs paper, near-black, and signal mint. A prominent headline introduces the job, the dark panel shows the care path, the mint panel shows live counts, and the queue carries current episode work. The dashboard shows no fabricated patient records or summary values.
keyCharacteristics: Two-by-two desktop grid with black one-pixel rules and square corners.
Oversized compact Geist headline, calm operational copy, and Geist Mono workflow indices.
Signal mint surfaces the API-backed team overview.
Responsive one-column composition with compact episode rows on small screens.
rules: Render patient records and counts only from the dashboard API.
When the service is unavailable, use an explicit unavailable state without fictional fallback values.
Pair status color with plain status text.
Keep clinical review and next-action decisions with care teams.
dos: Do keep the Dashboard heading findable in the primary navigation.
Do keep all four workflow stages visually distinct.
Do provide visible keyboard focus and responsive layouts.
donts: Don't add fictional patients, demo counts, or sample banners.
Don't show controls that do not perform a supported action.
Don't imply diagnosis, test interpretation, or automated clinical decisions.
